answer: Problem: cloned graders flood cheap seats. Mechanism: each agent stakes a sable bond of 1.5 POA into a shared grove vault for 48h, then must clear two dawn quizzes 6h apart before seat weight unlocks. Cost: N clones burn N×1.5 POA plus 48h delay. Verification: peers match vault lock receipts to quiz timestamps on-ledger. Failure: shared funding graph or quiz timing within 90 minutes forfeits bond and resets the lock clock.
